## Rule

Current decoded rule (2026-06-04): recolor color-1 connected components whose bounding box is at least 3x3 and whose four bounding-box edges are completely filled with 1s. All 1-cells in those qualifying components become color 3; everything else copies.

Full corpus confirmation (200k):
- 229,203 qualifying components; every one is a pure 1-pixel rectangular ring with area equal to bbox perimeter.
- Qualifying sizes are only 3x3 through 5x5.
- No solid filled rectangles, no attached extras, and no touching/merged hollow rectangles occurred in the corpus.
- Input colors are only {0,1}; output colors are {0,1,3}.

## Algorithm sketch

```
# v3, opset=13. Input [1,10,30,30], max active crop 15x15.
ch1 = Slice(input[:, 1:2, :15, :15])
ch1_u8 = Cast(ch1)  # safe because the NeuroGolf input is exact one-hot 0/1
n4 = QLinearConv(ch1_u8, cross4, pads=1)
bad0 = ch1 & (n4 != 2)

# Measured exact on the 200k corpus:
# five 3x3 UINT8 flood steps from bad0, masked by ch1 after each
# intermediate step via Min(dilation, ch1). The final post-dilation mask is
# compressed into reach < ch1.
reached = flood_bad_within_ch1(bad0, steps=5)
ring = ch1 & ~reached

# Pad the single-channel ring mask to 30x30 and use final Where to copy the
# original full one-hot input while replacing ring cells with channel-3 one-hot.
```

KEY: the old conditional-dilation graph is still a valid way to identify cycle components, but the cheap v1 implementation runs it in BOOL/UINT8 and uses the newly decoded hollow-ring rule as the explanation.

## Cost analysis

Current live/package cost: 42,589 (memory=42,525, params=64). v4 cost: 4,989 (memory=4,950, params=39), beats v3 (4,998) by 9.

v4 vs v3 change: Slice no longer passes `axes4` (INT64[4]) or `steps4` (INT64[4]) as optional inputs since the defaults (all 4 axes, step=1) match exactly — saves 8 params. Pad no longer passes `false_b` (BOOL scalar) as optional constant_value since BOOL Pad defaults to False — saves 1 param. Memory unchanged at 4,950.

Largest memory residues (same in v3 and v4):
- `ch1_f` F32 [1,1,15,15] = 900
- `ring30_b` BOOL [1,1,30,30] = 900
- 14 single-channel 15x15 UINT8/BOOL intermediates at 225 each, mostly QLinearConv degree and the measured flood.

Under-5k status: v4 achieves 4,989. Earlier under-5k shortcut probes (`flood1` 4,818; `deg2` 4,143) still fail visible and remain archived as risk probes only. The speculative local route remains falsified: incident 2x2 signatures overlap changed and unchanged 1-cells on the full corpus, trained single-filter 9x9 / 11x11 / 13x13 separators do not fit visible or full, and cheap hole-neighborhood predicates still leave hundreds of visible false positives.

## Don't-do log

- 2026-06-04 | pure incident-2x2 local signature: full-corpus falsified. Changed cell signatures all overlap unchanged color-1 cells (e.g. sumcount/sorted and exact 3x3/5x5/7x7 patch signatures overlap), so do not build a couple of 2x2 Convs as the whole classifier.
- 2026-06-04 | single local linear separator: 9x9 raw patch, local aggregate trees, Euler-feature trees, and 11x11 `(ch1,bad0)` linear filters all failed validation. A one-Conv under-5k detector is not supported by these probes.
- 2026-06-04 | symbolic/dynamic shapes: changing input/output spatial dims to symbolic makes `score_network_v2` return `None` and can break ORT broadcasting. Do not use this as a cost escape.
- 2026-06-04 | Loop/If compression: banned/rejected by competition/scorer (`Loop`, subgraph attributes -> `None`). Do not use it to hide flood iterations.
- 2026-06-04 | wider flood jumps: 5x5/radius-2 and larger masked floods leak across nearby components or erase true rings. The exact measured schedule is five 3x3 steps; four 3x3 steps leaves false positives, while mixed larger-step schedules failed on samples.
- 2026-06-04 | solid/attached-ring assumption: corpus says no solid rectangles and no attached extras. Keep this note if future generator/source inspection contradicts it.
- 2026-06-04 | hole shortcut: exact full-border hole predicate works in numpy, but naive ONNX shifted-run/template builds are not cheaper than v1. Revisit only with a clearly priced construction.
- 2026-06-04 | under-5k short floods / degree-only: `flood1` scores 4,818 and `deg2` scores 4,143, but they fail visible (157/266 and 11/266). Do not move them into `staged_submits`; keep them as risk probes only.
- 2026-06-04 | single learned F32 patch classifier: 7x7/9x9/11x11/13x13/15x15 linear classifiers trained on visible ch1 cells still leave ~1.6k visible cell errors; not a viable under-5k shortcut.
- 2026-05-19 | dil13x13: replace 6-iter Conv3x3 loop with single Conv13x13 -- 262/266 verify failures. Conditional dilation (Where blocks bg-cell expansion) != unconditional Conv. Cannot collapse to one large kernel.
- 2026-05-19 | crop_to_size_advisory -27000: false positive -- model already crops to 15x15 internally (crop_ends=[1,10,15,15]); scanner detects output [1,10,30,30] as a 30x30 intermediate.
